name: Ugly Bastard
source:
Lawrence P'weens is a grumpy old college professor; bored with his everyday life and hates his job. All of that changes when one of his students asks to drop out of class. The beauty of this boy gives him a wicked idea...

[From [url=https://bygesagirls.itch.io/ugly-bastard]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
劳伦斯·普威斯 (Lawrence P'weens) 是一位脾气暴躁的老大学教授。厌倦了他的日常生活并讨厌他的工作。当他的一名学生要求退学时，所有这一切都发生了变化。这个男孩的美貌让他产生了邪恶的想法……

[来自[url=https://bygesagirls.itch.io/ugly-bastard]Itch.io[/url]]
